Data Feeders Entities who gather and report the data from the source to the oracle system . Data Authentication: Establishing data integrity (e.g. TLSNotary) • Confidentiality • Non-Repudiation Mechanism: Tunnel spectrum through which data may be contaminated at source, at the stage of dating, or even after the event (e.g. Commit-reveal)

Server's Network - Any server has two sides of connections: • A connection between the off-chain components e.g. • A connection between the server and the blockchain (e.g. broadcasting to the blockchain using a node) . MITM attacks or blocking the connection (availability) • Many Network Partitioning attacks should be considered here Chil, Eclipse Attack, P2P DoS attacks

Transaction Creation The process of creating the required data blob, signing it using the private key, and broadcasting it to the network. • Secure storage & usage of private key • Hold enough funds for the transaction gas - Dynamic gasPrice calculation
Block Creation The process of transaction inclusion in a block by miners • mempool is a dark forest • Transaction Ordering - Front-running • Miner Extractable Value (MEV)

Oracle's Smart Contract The smart contract module as the main on-chain component to finalize the data and respond to the data consumer smart contract • Defects on the code & security issues . All possible smart contract vulnerabilities . Governance Decide on the Oracle's parameters (eg. Maker's bar)

The consumer of the data who needs data for its business logic • Defects on how to handle the oracle response & possible security flaws • Must do proper verification • Verify the Oracle smart contract (e.g. Nexus Mutual bug)
